checker_hardening: Post-campaign checker-only extension independently validates each native Redis key mutation sequence and SET/HSET MULTI/EXEC grouping; negative hidden-write/group-boundary and physical SQLite forgery tests. No engine/spec/result changes.

clarifications.clarification: Implemented receipt existence/body, receipt hash type/SQL column names, and effect-time version/epoch predicates over declared valid record inputs. Not arbitrary corrupt-state or universal schema validation.
Authored weaker prepared-new-write baseline; entry receipt/type inspection is outside primitive. Real Redis WRONGTYPE occurs after entry and before EVAL, not an external interleaving inside EVAL.
Physical accepted participant effects are distinct from foreign writes, revocation, acknowledgement, and usable receipt availability. Explicit GC intentionally removes receipts and is retained.
Common caller-side fsync/atomic-replace prepared journal, read before every request. Not supplied by Redis or SQLite operation receipt.
Actual os._exit(87) at semantic client barriers, not network packet loss, arbitrary instruction crash or power loss.
Redis script non-interleaving, SQL explicit exception rollback, AOF policy, and one application envelope mutation are different guarantees. Graceful server restart is a separate control.
Four authored bundles with different primitive/storage shapes and applicability. No vendor ranking or single-factor causal effect estimate.
Epoch increments, target version holds, current visibility cleared, historical outcomes retained. Visibility revocation, not physical erasure/unlearning.
